title: Marble
body:
Not to be confused with Marbles, a ball that can be bought at Alan's AutoLogistics

Description

Marble is one of the 5 nodes that can spawn around Finlay Island. These nodes can be found in elevated areas, most notably the Flowering Meadows. They are commonly found as large white nodes.

These nodes can spawn in a medium range of sizes.

Note: Gold, Rose Gold, Copper, Iron will not spawn in Marble deposits as of update 1.67.0.

The chart below displays all possible ores that spawn within this node.
Picture Name Notes
Quartz
Rosa Quartz 1/100

Trivia

  • It is currently one of the biggest stones in the game.
  • The Refined Marble is Slippery like ice (low friction), making it useful for Slippery Builds.
  • Marble may appear as a mineral in Lightslate
